name: 密码生成器（带强度检测）

map.如何使用密码生成器（带强度检测）？: How do I use Password Generator?
map.密码生成器（带强度检测）适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Password Generator best for?
map.自定义长度和字符类型，生成高强度随机密码，实时评估密码强度: Generate strong passwords with configurable length, character sets and ambiguity filters, and check the resulting strength.
map.强度分 = 长度 × 4 + 字符种类 × 10（≥12 位 +10、≥16 位: Strength score = length × 4 + character categories × 10 (≥12 chars +10, ≥16 chars +15, all four categories +15)
map.字符种类统计小写/大写/数字/符号四类中出现的种数。并设上限修正：长度 <8 位: The character categories count how many of the four types (lowercase / uppercase / digits / symbols) appear. Caps are also applied: length < 8 caps the score at 30, < 6 caps it at 15, and a single character category caps it at 25. By total score: < 30 weak, < 55 medium, < 80 strong, the rest very strong. The character pool is set by the checkboxes, and similar characters (0O1lI) and ambiguous characters can be excluded further.
map.生成并即时评强度。: Generate and score the strength instantly.
map.为不同网站生成互不相同的高强度口令，规避一处泄露牵连全部。: Generate a different strong password for each site, so one leak does not compromise them all.
map.16 位含四类 → `Tq7!mK9@pL2#vX4z`，强度强。: 16 chars with all four categories → `Tq7!mK9@pL2#vX4z`, strong.
map.不会。全部在浏览器本地生成，关闭页面即清除，服务端不接收；仍建议配合密码管理器保: No. Everything is generated locally in the browser and cleared when the page closes, and the server receives nothing; still, save passwords with a password manager.
map.本工具纯前端运行，密码在浏览器本地生成，不会上传到服务器: This tool runs entirely in the front end; passwords are generated locally in the browser and never uploaded to a server
map.建议密码长度至少12位，包含大小写字母、数字和符号: Aim for at least 12 characters, including upper and lower case letters, digits and symbols
map.每个账户使用不同密码，建议配合密码管理器使用: Use a different password for each account and pair it with a password manager
map.重要账户建议开启双重验证（2FA）: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for important accounts
map.免费在线密码生成器，支持自定义密码长度（4-64位）、字符类型（大小写字母、数字: A free online password generator that supports a custom length (4-64 characters) and character types (upper and lower case letters, digits, special symbols), and can exclude similar or ambiguous characters. It rates the strength (weak / medium / strong / very strong) right after generating, helping you create highly secure passwords. It runs entirely in the front end and passwords never leave your browser.
